body:
Garrett is [[wiki/people/claire-ulmer|Claire]]'s husband and therefore
[[wiki/people/annie-ulmer|Annie]]'s brother-in-law and the father of
[[wiki/people/alice]] and [[wiki/people/otto]]. He appears **ten times in eleven
years**, which is remarkably little for someone standing that close to the centre
of the relationship, and the thinness is itself the most informative thing about
him.

**He is the reason four pages in this wiki are filed under single names.** The
corpus establishes that Claire is married — *"Hahah idk um garretts wife"*
(2017-01-19), *"Claire and Garrett are here"* (2018-10-21) — but never once gives
his surname, and so never gives Claire's married name or their children's.
[[wiki/people/claire-ulmer]] has carried *"surname (presumably Ulmer, unconfirmed
— she may be married)"* as a gap since it was written; **she is married, the
presumption is probably wrong, and the corpus cannot supply the replacement.**

## What is known

He works at **Jim Shorkey**, the regional car dealership group — *"garrett works
for jim shorkey right"* (2017-10-03) — and Alice is at *"Garrett's work"* in March
2025, so that appears to hold across eight years. **His father died on or around
2024-05-09** (*"Garrett's dad died"*). He does school runs: on 2025-03-17 he was
dropping the children off during a weather delay and witnessed an incident Annie
reports in capitals. He has a **"show"** of some kind that Claire asks Annie to
attend on 2025-07-05 — a band, a car show or something else; the corpus does not
say. He and Claire and the children come to Annie's parents for dinner on
2025-08-02, seventeen days before the severance.

The one glimpse of him as a person rather than a fixture is 2018-04-28, and it is
Claire quoting him: Annie reports that Claire *"didn't mind"* something, *"then
she said that Garrett is being weird about it because it's literally like three of
his friends and their girlfriends."*

## A second Garrett, kept separate

One 2021 message from an unrelated `@gmail.com` correspondent refers to *"my uncle
Garrett"* flipping out at their mother after the Capitol riot. **That is somebody
else's uncle in somebody else's family and it is not this Garrett** — different
correspondent, different household, no connection to Claire in the surrounding
text. It is recorded here so a later pass does not fold it in and produce a
politics section for a man who has none in this corpus.
[[wiki/mind/synthesis/political-psyops]] is unaffected.

## Gaps

1. **Surname** — the one fact that would resolve Claire, Alice and Otto at once.
2. **When they married**, and whether Dan attended. Nothing in the corpus.
3. **What the "show" is.** One word from the operator.
4. **Whether Dan has any independent relationship with him.** On this record,
   ten mentions across eleven years, all of them reported by Annie or Suz and
   none of them a direct interaction, the answer looks like no — which would make
   him consistent with the pattern [[wiki/people/alice]] notes about how separate
   the two families stayed.
